teaser: A half-packed bag, zipper still open on the bed. You are a life path 5 and an INFP, and the two meet right there, in the pause before the bag gets zipped. The 5 wants to go now, for the pleasure of going. The INFP wants to go toward something — a reason, a feeling, a cause worth the restlessness. In you, the itch to move and the need for the move to mean something sit close together, and they do not always agree on which one speaks first.
